description: This file contains elliptic curve cryptography functions, including scalar multiplication and precomputation for elliptic curve points, specifically for the 'simple_mul' implementation in BoringSSL's FIPS module.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication on an elliptic curve point using a precomputed table, employing a windowed method for efficiency.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul_base
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of the generator point of the group.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_batch_precomp
methods.description: Precomputes multiples of a point for batch scalar multiplication.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_batch_get_window
methods.description: Retrieves a window of precomputed points based on scalar bits for batch processing.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul_batch
methods.description: Performs batch scalar multiplication for multiple points.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_init_precomp
methods.description: Initializes precomputed tables for a point to optimize repeated scalar multiplications.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_get_comb_window
methods.description: Gets a combined window of precomputed points for scalar multiplication using the comb method.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul_precomp
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication using precomputed tables and the comb method.
